missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Отделение' is neuter nominative as the subject of 'работает'. 'Это' agrees in the neuter, and 'по субботам' gives the schedule.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Отделение' is the accusative object of 'нашёл'; neuter nouns match the nominative form. 'Банка' is genitive meaning of the bank.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В отделении' uses the prepositional ending after 'в' to give the place of work. 'Этом' agrees in the neuter prepositional.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Отделения' is genitive after 'нет', and 'почтового' agrees in the neuter genitive. 'Рядом' shows there is none nearby.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Из отделения' takes the genitive after 'из' to show motion out. 'Полиции' is genitive meaning of the police.

missions.phrase: Я зашёл в отделение за посылкой.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'В отделение' uses the accusative after 'в' to show motion into the branch. 'За посылкой' is the instrumental purpose phrase.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'К отделению' uses the dative after 'к' to mean toward the branch. 'Новому' agrees in the neuter dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with preposition. 'Перед отделением' uses the instrumental after 'перед' to mean in front of the branch. 'Очередь' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Отделения' is the nominative plural subject. 'Все' quantifies them, and 'закрыты' is the short-form predicate, with 'сегодня' as time.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Отделений' is the genitive plural required after 'много'. 'В городе' is the prepositional location, and 'банка' is genitive.
